info.title: Koduvai Runners API
info.description: Versioned REST API. Responses are `{ data }` (or `{ data, meta }` for paginated lists); errors are `{ error: { code, message, details? } }`. Admin endpoints use the `kr_session` cookie set by /admin/login and enforce role permissions server-side (`x-permission`). Unsafe methods from browsers must come from APP_URL (Origin check). Money is integer minor units (paise).
